name: Form Boiler Room
implementation_notes: Boiler Room Detail grid renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from boilerRoomRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Engine Room Detail (screen-077's mobile precedent)

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23), mirroring FormEngineRoomView.vue's availableTimeSlotOptions() exactly

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 kolom bacaan/status/teks terisi) validated at FE + repo level (boilerRoomRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws BoilerRoomDetailRequiredError) -- this station has 15 non-time_slot columns, all of which participate in the 'filled' check (no identifying/context columns to exclude)

The 2 enum status columns (Blowdown Executed, Sootblowing Executed: Y/N) are each rendered as a native <select> dropdown with a '-- Pilih --' empty option, styled with the existing .native-select CSS class; local SQLite has no CHECK constraint so no empty-string coercion is required in this repo (unlike the web backend, see screen-098/118)

The 3 free-text columns (Fuel Feed Rate, ID Fan Load, SA Fan Load) are rendered as plain text FormFields, not numeric inputs, because their paper-form units are mixed/ambiguous (Hz/%/tons, A/%) per the entity-catalog's actual field type
UNLIKE Form Threshing/Form Effluent Plant: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no CollapsibleSection, no static-constant data file, per this station's explicit scope

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. steam-pressure-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- FormField.vue's default id-from-label slug would otherwise collide, same defensive pattern as FormEngineRoomView.vue

Field order in the grid & template mirrors the migration column order exactly: Steam Pressure -> Steam Temp -> Feed Water Temp -> Feed Water Tank Level -> Boiler Water Level -> Water TDS -> Water pH -> Fuel Feed Rate -> ID Fan Load -> SA Fan Load -> Exhaust Gas Temp -> Dust Collector Differential Pressure -> Blowdown Executed -> Sootblowing Executed -> Findings = 15 total

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak): FormBoilerRoomView menyimpan ke SQLite lokal tanpa memeriksa periode; satu-satunya panggilan server dari form ini adalah write-through syncAfterSave('boiler_room_record') → pushSavedRecordNow → POST /api/boiler-room-records bila Mills Setting immediate_sync_enabled aktif. Kegagalan offline/5xx diam; penolakan 4xx (termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED) sejak 2026-10-03 ditampilkan langsung di form (lihat catatan REVISI 2026-10-03 di bawah), dan pada sinkron manual screen-006 alasannya tampil di SyncResultDialog. Guard EnforcesPeriodLock::assertPeriodOpenForWrite('boiler-room', mill, date) di BoilerRoomRecordService::create() menilai periode saat request tiba (bukan saat dicatat). Form hanya membuka draft lokal; tidak ada jalur edit/PATCH record tersinkron dari mobile. Cakupan: backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist + 'ke-18 *RecordService memanggil guard pada create MAUPUN update'), backend/tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php ('menolak 422 PERIOD_CLOSED untuk data mobile yang menyusul, lalu menerimanya setelah periode dibuka kembali'), mobile/tests/syncService.spec.ts (gagal per record dengan reason dari server, galat generik), dan mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts (hasil {synced, rejection} write-through).

REVISI (2026-10-03): penolakan write-through kini ditampilkan — writeThroughSync.syncAfterSave('boiler_room_record') mengembalikan {synced, rejection}; bila server menolak dengan 4xx (mis. 422 PERIOD_CLOSED, usecase-141) rejection berisi pesan server dan FormBoilerRoomView membuka ConfirmDialog satu tombol (cancel-label kosong) 'Tersimpan, tetapi ditolak server' berisi pesan tersebut, lalu bernavigasi ke Monitor Boiler Room saat ditutup (tombol 'Mengerti' maupun klik overlay). Record tetap 'saved' di SQLite lokal dan dapat dikirim ulang lewat sinkron Station List setelah masalahnya diselesaikan. Offline/5xx/fitur nonaktif tetap diam. Cakupan test: mobile/tests/writeThroughSync.spec.ts (generik, termasuk 422 PERIOD_CLOSED → rejection berisi pesan); tidak ada test komponen khusus untuk form ini — test komponen representatif ada di mobile/tests/FormThreshingView.spec.ts.

REVISI 2026-10-03 (e2e): spec Playwright mobile/tests/e2e/form-boiler-room.spec.ts ditulis (13 test) dan lulus dalam run penuh suite Playwright mobile (727 lulus / 0 gagal, 65 spec) — known issue 'spec e2e belum ada' ditutup.

REVISI (2026-10-04, audit-fix — sinkronisasi artefak, kode adalah acuan): (1) label catatan 'Note' → 'Catatan' dengan id eksplisit field-note di FormBoilerRoomView.vue (dikunci mobile/tests/noteLabelConsistency.spec.ts). (2) boilerRoomRecordRepo.createDraft() mengisi `date` dengan tanggal LOKAL 'YYYY-MM-DD' via todayLocalDateString() (mobile/src/utils/localDate.ts), bukan ISO UTC; nilai lama bersufiks zona dinormalisasi sekali oleh localSchema.normalizeLegacyUtcDates() (mobile/tests/localDate.sqljs.spec.ts). (3) write-through kini benar-benar aktif saat immediate_sync_enabled=true — millSettingRepo.getMillSetting() sebelumnya tidak men-SELECT kolom itu (mobile/tests/millSettingRepo.sqljs.spec.ts, writeThroughSync.spec.ts). (4) syncService mengirim `date` lokal, menyimpan alasan penolakan server ke kolom sync_error (ditampilkan Data Preview sebagai 'Gagal sinkron: <alasan>'), dan sinkron memakai Production Line stasiun record (mobile/tests/syncService.sqljs.spec.ts). (5) ConfirmDialog di-teleport ke <body> (z-index 1200) (mobile/tests/DialogTeleport.spec.ts). Angka test_results tidak diubah.
